import ctypes
import os

# Load GSL libraries

def load_gsl_libraries():
    # Load libgslcblas.so globally first
    ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    # Load libgsl.so
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")
    return gsl

# Compute Pascal CDF and CCDF

def compute_pascal_cdf_and_ccdf(k, p, n):
    gsl = load_gsl_libraries()

    # Define argument and return types for gsl_cdf_pascal_P
    gsl.gsl_cdf_pascal_P.argtypes = [ctypes.c_uint, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_uint]
    gsl.gsl_cdf_pascal_P.restype = ctypes.c_double

    # Define argument and return types for gsl_cdf_pascal_Q
    gsl.gsl_cdf_pascal_Q.argtypes = [ctypes.c_uint, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_uint]
    gsl.gsl_cdf_pascal_Q.restype = ctypes.c_double

    # Call the functions
    cdf = gsl.gsl_cdf_pascal_P(ctypes.c_uint(k), ctypes.c_double(p), ctypes.c_uint(n))
    ccdf = gsl.gsl_cdf_pascal_Q(ctypes.c_uint(k), ctypes.c_double(p), ctypes.c_uint(n))

    return cdf, ccdf

# Assertion-based test cases

def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: Valid inputs
    k, p, n = 5, 0.5, 10
    cdf, ccdf = compute_pascal_cdf_and_ccdf(k, p, n)
    assert abs(cdf - 0.15087890625) < 1e-6, f"Test case 1 failed: cdf={cdf}"
    assert abs(ccdf - 0.84912109375) < 1e-6, f"Test case 1 failed: ccdf={ccdf}"

    # Test case 2: Edge case with k=0
    k, p, n = 0, 0.5, 10
    cdf, ccdf = compute_pascal_cdf_and_ccdf(k, p, n)
    assert abs(cdf - 0.0009765625) < 1e-6, f"Test case 2 failed: cdf={cdf}"
    assert abs(ccdf - 0.9990234375) < 1e-6, f"Test case 2 failed: ccdf={ccdf}"

    # Test case 3: Edge case with p=1.0
    k, p, n = 5, 1.0, 10
    cdf, ccdf = compute_pascal_cdf_and_ccdf(k, p, n)
    assert abs(cdf - 1.0) < 1e-6, f"Test case 3 failed: cdf={cdf}"
    assert abs(ccdf - 0.0) < 1e-6, f"Test case 3 failed: ccdf={ccdf}"

    assert_test()
